audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows disagreed with their own why: win[0], win[3] and win[4] read Skill while the whys said Riven, and win[5] and win[6] read Riven while the whys said Skill and Tryndamere.
audit.why: The packet chart and this page's prose agree that Riven owns levels 1 through 6, first item is even, and Tryndamere takes over on two items; the mirror separately moved row 6 to Tryndamere. Riven has four dashes to Tryndamere's one and a complete combo at 3.
audit.corrected: Riven, Riven, Riven, Riven, Riven, Skill, Tryndamere with ratings 4,3,3,3,3,5,7, in matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] built the first-item spike on 'Battle Fury', and no cooldown appeared for any Riven ability.
audit.why: Battle Fury is not a current item name. The numbers that make the advice actionable are Broken Wings 13s across all three casts, Ki Burst 11/10/9/8/7s at 260, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s, and Blade of the Exile 120/90/60s — a 60-second ultimate at rank 3 is the reason her level-6 pressure never really goes away.
audit.corrected: Item name removed and the four cooldowns written into spikes[2], mid and the phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and mid call Blade of the Exile an 'execute', and Mocking Shout never appeared in the content layer.
audit.why: Riot's R text grants Attack Damage and Range plus a single Wind Slash — no execute threshold. Mocking Shout (850 range, 14s) cuts the attack damage her whole combo is built on, which is the one lever Tryndamere holds in this lane, but its slow only lands on enemies whose backs are turned, and Riven repositions with dashes rather than turning, so the slow half rarely applies.
audit.corrected: Execute claim removed from whys[4] and mid; Mocking Shout written into mid and phases[3].why with the back-turned condition stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] tells the player to buy Executioner's Calling early because 'his healing fights your pattern', and breakdown.late says anti-heal stays core.
audit.why: Riven's kit contains no healing at all — Runic Blade, Broken Wings, Ki Burst, Valor and Blade of the Exile are damage, CC, a shield and a stat buff. This is gold spent on a stat that does nothing in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Both lines rewritten to say skip anti-heal here.

edits.after: Riven starts ahead: Broken Wings is three casts on one 13s cooldown and the third knocks you back. Farm it and take nothing.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Riven must walk into your engage range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ki Burst's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still hers: Mocking Shout cuts her AD from 850 every 14s, but its slow only lands with her back turned — and she dashes instead.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Riven's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile runs 120/90/60s and hands her bonus AD, range and one Wind Slash — Undying Rage survives it, but she still takes the trade at 6.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ki Burst's cooldown.
